content.text:
Resubmitted with the minimality defects repaired.

**Changes made in response to the verifier:**
1. **Op 1 trimmed** — Article XXII now reads only "ARTICLE XXII NO RIGHT OF FIRST REFUSAL The Licensor shall have no right of first refusal or right to match." The surplus negative covenant ("no other right to be notified of or to receive any terms that the Licensee offers to or receives from a third party") was removed; it added operative breadth beyond the single preferred element.
2. **Op 2 narrowed** — the follow-on sentence opener is now conformed to just "The", so p0140–p0141 read "The Licensee shall have the right to consummate the transaction with the third party." The words "without notice to or the consent of the Licensor" are gone, eliminating the fresh consent-free permission and the override risk against the retained assignment (p0149) and Change of Control (p0134) consent provisions.
3. **Op 3 dropped** — the retained wording "the transaction with the third party" is left verbatim.

Classification is unchanged: deviation, cured at the preferred level, with the single preferred element addressed by operations 1–2. No duplicate flag under ASSIGN.
